profile.headline: Software Engineer
profile.summary:
Current SDE in Amazon Web Services (AWS) S3 after graduating Northeastern MSCS program.

Before starting the Masters program, I was an analyst in the Natixis Corporate and Investment Bank for 2+ years. I graduated NYU Stern School of Business with concentration in finance and statistics, and minor in math and computer science. I believe all four areas of studies can create great synergy for my future career in the finance sector.

Prior to joining Natixis, I have worked in Venture Capital firms including &Beyond and IMM, and Debt Capital Markets in HSBC Securities and Bank of America Merrill Lynch.

Please kindly let me know if you have any additional questions.

positions.title: Software Engineer Intern
positions.description: SDE Intern in AWS FsX Windows team.

positions.title: Analyst
positions.description:
 Assessed project companies’ future cash flows and potential risks to create financial models for debt sizing, sensitivity analysis, and debt structuring.
 Reviewed documentations including term sheets, deal sheets, and credit agreements with legal counsels for transactions.
 Analyzed various contracts and consultant reports to identify project risks for the purpose of internal credit committees.
 Managed pitch book database for generic slides and built specific slides for each transaction pitch stages.

positions.title: Summer Analyst
positions.description:
 Assessed the project companies’ future cash flows and potential risks to create financial models for sizing the maximum available debt and most attractive terms for each companies
 Drafted documentations including term sheets, deal sheets, credit applications, and proposals for the mandate processes and internal credit committee meetings
 Performed market research in the telecom sector to assess the current market trend and needs of 20+ players in the market

positions.title: Part-Time Analyst
positions.description:
 Analyzed a company going through IPO process in the U.S. to benchmark for an on-going investment
 Conducted a research on the POS market and the four leading players to analyze the strength and weaknesses of an on-going investment and advised about future operation and investment management
 Reformulated the financial statements of a potential investee and evaluated its current financial status

positions.title: Summer Analyst
positions.description:
 Created a presentation of IMM’s investment proposal for Korean investors in conjunction with Bravia Capital on a US$205MM leveraged buy-out opportunity and participated in the meeting of 30+ members as an interpreter
 Drafted two preliminary investment review on investments by researching the industry, analyzing the business model, and valuating the company using EV/EBITDA ratio ranges along with the company’s forecasted financials
 Developed a case study of a closed investment that explains IMM’s early planning stage, valuation using comparable company analysis, value creation process, and possible exit options such as M&A and IPO
 Compiled 9 years of IMM’s mezzanine deals on Celltrion group for the CEO’s meeting with the LPs

positions.title: Summer Analyst
positions.description:
 Created a company profile for a US$300MM bond issuance of NH bank by researching its role in the Korean economy as the sole leading agricultural bank and the financial incentives it receives from the government
 Drafted client presentations including a pitch book for a Korean financial conglomerate’s bond issuance
 Updated daily US treasury and major corporate bond rates using the Bloomberg terminal for the analyst and director

positions.title: Sergeant; Squad Leader
positions.description:
 Worked as the sole manager of the $400K budget as well as HR and operation management of CBR Defense Institute for 20 months and was rewarded by the head of CBRDI (Colonel Kim) for excellent management
 Educated 20+ people around the world as a leading instructor of the OPCW event of CBR Defense Command about wearing protective suits and gears in case of chemical or biological attack
 Participated in high-profile exercises such as KR/FE and UFG with the US Army as the Deputy Commander’s personal interpreter and managed interpretation of Battle Update Briefings for 50+ military officers

positions.title: Summer Analyst
positions.description:
 Created investor profiles of potential investors in Los Angeles and Singapore for road shows of major Korean issuers such as POSCO and Hyundai Capital by researching background information and investment approach
 Compiled daily market updates to inform clients about the market trends, notable news and changes in US treasury and major corporate bond rates
